recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast macro shot of a chocolate bar partially revealed by a torn black and silver foil wrapper, featuring a large, centered logo molded directly into the chocolate surface in high relief.
coreVisualRelationships: Torn wrapper edges framing the central chocolate surface
High-relief molded lettering matching the chocolate's matte texture
Contrast between crinkled reflective foil and smooth matte chocolate
Monochromatic brown palette with metallic silver accents
coreInvariants: Molded 3D typography integrated into the material
Jagged, diagonal tear in the outer packaging
Subtle top-down lighting creating soft shadows in the relief

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The molded logo is centered and occupies approximately 60% of the visible chocolate surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large initial capital letter of the logo serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal tear from the top left to the bottom right, settling on the central embossed text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The smooth chocolate surface to the right of the logo provides breathing room against the busy texture of the foil.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cocoa brown (chocolate surface and molded text).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between the dark chocolate and the reflective foil highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Continuous monolinear script with thick, rounded strokes
Extensive swashes and flourishes that loop back into the letterforms
Beveled edges to simulate a 3D mold in chocolate
Interlocking characters where the descenders and ascenders overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital with a large, encircling swash
Terminal flourishes that underline the subsequent letters

treatment.shadow: Soft directional drop shadow to define depth

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom script; secondary technical metadata in a clean sans-serif at the bottom.

avoid: Modern geometric sans-serifs for the main logo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, connected, and flourished nature of the original lettering.
Provides the necessary decorative swashes and formal weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A macro photograph of a smooth, matte dark chocolate bar. A black wrapper with a silver foil lining is torn open diagonally from the top left to the bottom right, revealing the chocolate. Soft studio lighting from the top creates subtle highlights on the foil and soft shadows on the chocolate.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom script logo in the center of the chocolate. The logo must be rendered as a 3D relief mold (embossed) out of the chocolate itself, with beveled edges and soft shadows to indicate depth. The color and texture of the logo must perfectly match the chocolate bar.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like it is part of the chocolate mold?
Is the foil texture crinkled and reflective?
Is the tear in the wrapper jagged and realistic?
Is the color palette strictly brown, black, and silver?

mustRedesign: Exact weight measurements or fine print text

mustAchieve: Realistic 3D depth in the molded text
Tactile contrast between foil and chocolate

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the 3D effect
Check that the lighting on the text matches the lighting on the foil
Verify the foil looks like real aluminum/silver material
Confirm the brown tones are appetizing and rich
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro shot of [Material A] partially revealed by a torn [Material B] wrapper, featuring [Custom Script Logo] embossed into [Material A] with high-relief 3D effects.
